description: Single source of truth for Keystone engineering conventions. Consumed by the devex CLI (Python) for local validation AND by @keystone/platform (TypeScript) to generate CI workflows. One definition, zero drift between local and CI.

workId.description: Mandatory Work ID linking every change to a tracked unit of work. Required in branch names, commit messages, and PR titles. It is the 'why' link for the audit trail.

branch.description: type/<WORK-ID>-<kebab-slug>. The type prefix mirrors conventional-commit types.

examples: fix: TX-19: retry on gateway timeout
commit.description: Conventional-commit type + scope, with the Work ID embedded in the subject.

pullRequest.description: Work ID required in the title. Two-reviewer approval rule enforced by branch protection + generated workflow.

telemetry.description: Language-agnostic event contract. Because @keystone/platform generates the workflows, every team emits this identical shape regardless of app language (Python, Go, Clojure, TypeScript). This is what makes DORA metrics comparable.
